messages:
amy: Quick doc change: add a short 'region + cooldown' note to Dedicated Provisioning. Want a tiny YAML autoscale example, one-line Go SDK snippet, and a rollforward checklist. cc @ron @claire.

ron: SGTM. Key points: prefer same-region reserved pools, fallback to cross-region with data-residency callout. Mention cooldown to avoid thrash (example: 120s).

claire: Add a one-liner about isolation_label and eviction_grace_period. Link to eng-sre runbook for preemption thresholds.

amy: Draft Go snippet (1-liner style):
```go
client := redwood.NewDedicatedClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
prov, _ := client.Provisionings.Create(redwood.ProvisionRequest{TenantID: "acct_123", Model: "gpt-medium", RegionAffinity: "us-west-2", ReservedPool: "us-west-2-reserved-1"})
fmt.Println(prov.ID)
```

amy: YAML autoscale example to paste: 
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 6
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  policy: cpu
```

ron: Rollforward checklist suggestion (short):
- confirm failing metric (p95/error)
- attempt rollforward: `redwood-cli provision rollforward --id <id> --pool <pool>`
- if unavailable, revert traffic to previous version
- reassign tenant to previous pool via SDK
- run smoke tests for 10m; escalate if still failing

docs-bot: docs build OK. 1 link suggestion: point /ops/infra/terragrunt/provisioning to README.md.

amy: I'll open a tiny PR with these bits and the link fix. Thanks :thumbsup:
